title: Error with Libre trend
body:
xDrip Bluetooth collection worked so far. But now all of a sudden the libre trend does not work anymore. The logs show: "libreBlock exists but no matching bg record exists" and "BG data was not calculated, working on raw data". xDrip was recently calibrated. "Show libre trend" shows "display error".What can I do to fix this? Also, the main screen shows three triangles with exclamation marks. What do these mean?

EDIT: Scanning with NFC removed the three triangles, but "show libre trend" is still not working. Using the SweetReader.

This is version a30ed57-2018.05.10 .

comments.body:
What hw are you using for the scan?
In any case, this might happen if there is a too often scan. Is the issue resolved after a few minutes?
I am using SweetReader with a Samsung S8. The issue is still not resolved.
I'm sorry, but I'm not familiar with the sweet reader. Do you know if it passess the full scans?

Hmm looking at the code it seems that the Libre trends are NFC specific? Meaning that this won't work with the SweetReader?

EDIT: The regular scans work. It periodically collects BG values from the SweetReader. I double checked with finger stick measurement, and they match. (I also calibrated with the finger stick results afterwards.)

Libretrend works with everything that brings the entire nfc block always: so it works with 
tomato, librealarm, bluekon (oop mode) and direct scans by phone.

We need to understand how sweet reader works to see how to enable it there as well.

Ah, okay. This explains it. Prior to getting the LibreReader, I scanned via NFC with the phone.

However, I turn off "Show libre trend", and yet I see the "Show libre trend" menu item?

@dv1 Would you please close this issue if you have the answer you were looking for?
If not, you can use the support channels.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
Thanks
